Type of Review: Adverse determination, level of care, inpatient versus observation

Determination

Cascade Mutual has completed a level of care review of the above admission and has issued an adverse determination regarding the billed inpatient level of care. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria. This adverse determination addresses level of care only, inpatient versus observation.

Claim Adjustment Codes Applied

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

Criteria Applied and Findings

Review was conducted using MCG-style criteria. The following criteria codes were found not met:

CHF-01: Oxygen saturation at presentation did not show hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen therapy.

CHF-02: Diuresis was achieved with a single intravenous dose and could have been managed with oral medication.

No other criteria codes were applied in this level of care determination.

Effect of This Determination

The inpatient level of care billed for the period from [[ADMIT_DATE]] to [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] is not certified. This notice concerns the level of care only and does not address any other aspect of the claim.

Appeal Rights

You or your authorized representative may submit a written appeal addressed to Utilization Management, Cascade Mutual. The appeal should reference the guideline code and the specific finding being disputed for each argument presented. An appeal that addresses CHF-01 should respond to the finding stated above for that code, and an appeal that addresses CHF-02 should respond to the finding stated above for that code.

The appeal submission must include a physician attestation line signed by the treating or reviewing physician.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that time may not be eligible for review.

Supporting documentation, including the admission record and physician orders relied upon, may be submitted with the written appeal.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
